description: This file defines the internal class SiloInstanceTableEntry, which models a table entity for Azure Table Storage representing a silo instance in Orleans clustering. It includes properties for silo metadata, methods for constructing and unpacking row keys, and a custom ToString implementation.

classes.name: SiloInstanceTableEntry
classes.description: Represents a table entity for a silo instance in Azure Table Storage, including properties for silo metadata, methods for constructing and parsing row keys, and a custom string representation.

methods.name: ConstructRowKey
methods.description: Constructs a row key string from a SiloAddress object, combining address, port, and generation separated by hyphens.

methods.name: UnpackRowKey
methods.description: Parses a row key string to extract the IP address, port, and generation, returning a SiloAddress object.
